+from typing import Annotated
+
+from fastapi import Depends, FastAPI, Response
+from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
+
+app = FastAPI()
+
+
+async def modify_response(response: Response):
+    response.headers["x-test"] = "test"
+
+
+@app.get("/annotated", response_model=None)
+async def get_annotated(response: Annotated[Response, Depends(modify_response)]):
+    return {"msg": "Hello World"}
+
+
+@app.get("/default", response_model=None)
+async def get_default(response: Response = Depends(modify_response)):
+    return {"msg": "Hello World"}
+
+
+@app.get("/regular", response_model=None)
+async def get_regular(response: Response):
+    return {"msg": "Hello World"}
+
+
+client = TestClient(app)
+
+
+def test_response_dependency_annotated():
+    response = client.get("/annotated")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"msg": "Hello World"}
+    assert response.headers["x-test"] == "test"
+
+
+def test_response_dependency_default():
+    response = client.get("/default")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
+    assert response.json() == {"msg": "Hello World"}
+    assert response.headers["x-test"] == "test"
+
+
+def test_response_dependency_regular():
+    response = client.get("/regular")
+    assert response.status_code == 200, response.text
